branding.title: Timer App
branding.subtitle: A full-screen countdown for meetings and live events

sections.text: Timer App turns any meeting or workshop into a full screen countdown that everyone in the room can read.
Every countdown starts with a two step setup. Step one collects the details, and step two picks how the clock animates.
Name the countdown first. The description is required, capped at eighty characters with a live counter, and it follows the timer all the way through to the summary.
Then set the length in hours, minutes and seconds. Each field takes digits only and clamps itself to a valid range as you type.
You can also write the message the timer celebrates with at the end. Leave it blank and it falls back to a plain Time's Up.

Once a countdown is running, the clock takes over the screen. The timer is stored in the browser, so closing the tab does not lose it. Here is a fifteen minute standup that was paused with thirteen and a half minutes left.
Resume picks it up from exactly where it stopped.
While it runs, the screen keeps only what matters: the name of the session and digits big enough to read from the back of the room.
Underneath the clock you get the start time, the projected finish, a progress bar and the percentage already elapsed.
A toggle in the corner pushes the whole timer into fullscreen for a projector or a second display.
Pause freezes the remaining time, and Cancel clears the session and returns you to setup.
Step two of setup picks how the clock animates, and four styles ship with the app. Default pops each digit card as it changes.
Slide rolls the digits over like an odometer.
Fade blurs one digit into the next, and flip is the hinged flip clock you saw a moment ago.
When the clock reaches zero the timer celebrates with confetti and the custom message you wrote during setup.
A summary card logs the date, when the session started and ended, and the total time it was scheduled for.
One click clears everything and drops you back at setup, ready for the next session.
